educational_note: Every amount and improvement rate is a fictional, editable assumption for learning; none is restaurant data or an industry benchmark.

components.name: Manager reconciliation
components.description: Assumed manager time associated with the investigated reconciliation friction.

components.name: Avoidable food waste
components.description: Only the assumed avoidable portion of waste, not total food cost.

components.name: Scheduling labor inefficiency
components.description: Assumed avoidable labor time, separate from manager reconciliation.

components.name: Preventable operational errors
components.description: Assumed economic cost of avoidable ordering and rush-purchase events.

components.name: Lost contribution from missed opportunities
components.description: Assumed contribution forgone, not gross sales revenue and not profit.
